meta.title: ML courses mini knowledge base
meta.domain: ML/AI courses at real universities (6 courses, 4 universities)
meta.provenance: Every A-box triple has `src`: a record in universities/exports/site/courses.json (`courses.json#items[N].field`, a passage id from `passages`, or `modelling` for our own topic typing). T-box and R-box are our design (`modelling`), not data.
meta.caveat: Prerequisites and topics are not columns in courses.json; they come from the syllabus pages in the crawl cache (cache/raw), quoted verbatim in `passages` (quotes verified as substrings). CPSC 320 and CPSC 221 appear only inside the CPSC 440/340 pages.

record_value.university: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
record_value.title: ELEG5491: Introduction to Deep Learning

passages.text: 2 Regression 3 Gradient Descent 4 Classification 5 Feature Representation 6 Neural Networks 7 Convolutional Neural Networks 8 Representation Learning 9 Transformers 10 Non-parametric Models

Probabilistic foundations of machine learning; offered in fall semesters; 12 units (3-0-9) Prerequisites: Introductory machine learning (at the level of 6.390 or 6.370 or 6.C01 ) ... Probabilistic thinking is critical to understanding machine learning, in techniques ranging from classic linear models to modern deep networks. We will study model representation, generalization, learning algorithms, and model-selection
Data clustering, outlier detection, and association rules. Linear prediction, regularization, and kernels. Latent-factor models and collaborative filtering. Neural networks and deep learning.
Mon Sep 12 Decision Trees ... Wed Nov 16 Principal Component Analysis ... Fri Dec 2 Convolutional Neural Networks
Prerequisites : Basic algorithms and data structures (CPSC 221,
Topics will (roughly) include deep learning, generative models, latent-variable models, Markov models, probabilistic graphical models, and Bayesian methods.

Prerequisites : CPSC 320: Intermediate Algorithm Design and Analysis. Note that this course itself has the following prerequisites: Basic algorithms and data structures (CPSC 221 or EECE 320). CPSC 340: Machine Learning and Data Mining.
The class is intended as a continuation of CPSC 340 (or 532M)

Course syllabus ELEG5491: Introduction to Deep Learning ... Convolutional neural networks (CNN) I ... Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) ... Deep belief net and auto-encoder I ... Generative adversarial network (GAN) I

Lecture: Deep Learning ... including convolutional networks and graph neural networks. The course will also address deep generative models such as auto-encoders, variational auto-encoders and generative adversarial networks.

graphrag_question.text: Which courses cover any deep-learning topic?
graphrag_question.why_keyword_misses: ex:MIT_6_390: its notes list 'Convolutional Neural Networks' and 'Transformers' but never the phrase 'deep learning'.
graphrag_question.caveat: Keyword match = literal phrase 'deep learning' in the stored passage text. The expected answers are computed by rules in this file (see check), not hand-picked; the topic typing (CNN is a DeepLearningTopic) is our modelling choice.

check.command: uv run --with rdflib --with owlrl --with pyshacl python data/run_reasoner_check.py
check.filter: Inferred triples are kept when the subject is an IRI/bnode in ex: and the object is in ex: or the predicate is rdf:type. Dropped: meta-class typing (owl:Thing, rdfs:Resource, owl:Class ...), owl:sameAs/equivalence, reflexive sub*Of, literal subjects. The JS reasoner is compared with this filtered set.
